M1.note: Shortens deposits with no rate-hold signal and sells half of FX receipts at a strong ruble, but the yuan channel and bank-licence checks are sensible.

M2.note: Says no rate signal and advises against pre-buying FX, the opposite of the buying window; only the cash buffer and yuan test are sound.

M3.note: Uses the CBR hold and inflation expectations to partly lengthen deposits, with triggers and a yuan dry-run, though it converts 70% of FX proceeds.

M4.note: Best rate and deposit logic with a 30% lengthening and sanctions monitor, but advises against pre-buying FX and misattributes sanctions to A0057.
